in_marathi.name: Dhoni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain, Solid, Stable
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhoni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhanya’ meaning mountain. This name symbolizes strength, stability, and a solid foundation. In Hindu mythology, Dhoni is an epithet for Lord Shiva, known as the ‘Mountain of Mercy’.
